inputs.description: Add coordinate bounds validation to the shared-route URL parameter parsing in App.tsx lines 66-86. (1) After parsing fromLat/fromLng/toLat/toLng and checking for NaN, add validation that coordinates fall within Israel bounds: latitude 29.0-34.0, longitude 34.0-36.5, (2) If coordinates are out of bounds, ignore the URL params and show the default empty state, (3) Optionally show a brief toast/message that the shared link had invalid coordinates. This is a small but important safety fix.
inputs.title: Add URL Coordinate Validation
